messages.subject: Our outstanding balance - an honest word from Walt
messages.body:
Morning Helen,

Walt Pruitt here, Harbor Express. I reckon you all have been more than patient with us and I want you to hear it straight from the horse's mouth: we're behind, and I'm sorry as can be about it.

Truth is our biggest fleet customer stretched their payments to 75 days this spring and we've been robbing Peter to pay Paul ever since. It ain't that the work ain't coming in — it's that the cash arrives late and leaves early.

I'd be mighty obliged if you could hold off on anything drastic a few more weeks. You've been good folks to us and I don't want that changing over an invoice.

Warmly,
Walt Pruitt
Owner, Harbor Express

messages.subject: Harbor Express - €27,400 overdue, propose suspending at 60 days
messages.body:
Dear Marta,

Harbor Express is now €27,400 overdue, past 60 days. The owner is apologetic and responsive, and has offered €8,000 within two weeks with no firm date on the remainder, pending a refinancing he cannot evidence.

I would gently propose the following: suspend service at the 60-day mark in accordance with our terms, and terminate at 90 days unless the balance is paid in full. Aisha estimates service impact as low — they use basic routing only. Writing it off would set an unhappy precedent for the other small accounts, and an open-ended payment plan simply converts our receivable into a loan we never agreed to make.

May I proceed on that basis?

Kind regards,
Helen

Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Harbor Express - €27,400 overdue, propose suspending at 60 days
messages.body:
Dear Ms Oyelaran,

We concur with the proposed course of action. Suspension at 60 days and termination at 90 days absent payment are both available under clause 11.2 of the standard terms, provided written notice is given to the address designated therein and any suspension is applied consistently with the terms of clause 11.4. We recommend that the suspension notice be issued by registered mail in addition to email, and that correspondence in the interim be preserved.

Yours sincerely,
Nadia Petrova
Okafor Lindqvist Advocaten

messages.subject: RE: Harbor Express - €27,400 overdue, propose suspending at 60 days
messages.body:
ok. suspend at 60, terminate at 90 if unpaid. take the €8,000 if it actually arrives.

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Harbor Express - formal notice of service suspension
messages.body:
Dear Walt,

Further to my email of Friday, and having concluded our internal review, I regret to inform you that we must proceed formally.

Your account is more than 60 days overdue. In accordance with clause 11.2 of our terms of service, access to the Parcelwise platform will be suspended as of 25 May 2026, and the agreement may be terminated if the outstanding balance of €27,400 is not settled within 90 days of the original due date.
